newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokai Bank opens ATM in convenience store.
newsitem.headline: Tokai Bank opens ATM in convenience store.

text.p: Tokai Bank Ltd said on Monday that it had set up an automatic teller machine (ATM) in a Nagoya convenience store.
A bank spokesman said the ATM at the Circle K Japan Co Ltd store was the first in Japan to be set up by a major commercial bank at a convenience store.
He added the bank may install ATMs in other convenience stores, but said there were no concrete plans to do so yet.
However, the ATM's access hours will be same as those for ATMs at the bank's branches -- between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. on weekdays and between 8 a.m. and 5 p.m. on weekends and holidays, he said.
Circle K is headquartered in Nagoya.
